Increases the caster's PvE Damage Tolerance by 20%, PvP Damage Tolerance by 10%, and grants a 5% chance to inflict Frost for 3s on enemies that attack the caster from within 7m for <chat_combat>10s</>. Grants Magic Displacement while MP is 50% or more for the duration.

Unaffected by cooldown increase effects.
